values: 连续攻击一名敌人，并使其无法回复生命值并持续受到伤害。
Harak viciously strikes an enemy, dealing continuous damage and preventing them from recovering HP.
狂暴地连续攻击一名敌人，持续击飞这名敌人并造成10段60% + 10% ATK伤害，最后一击造成200% + 20% ATK伤害并将敌人击倒，每段伤害额外附带敌人已损失生命值6%的伤害，且额外伤害最高不超过自身120%攻击力。本技能释放期间，哈拉克处于霸体状态，命中敌人后使敌人不能回复生命值，持续6秒，期间该敌人每秒流失40% ATK生命值。

Harak launches a vicious assault, striking an enemy 10 times, each dealing 60% + 10% ATK damage. Each strike also deals extra damage equal to 6% of the enemy's lost HP, up to 120% of Harak's own ATK. The final strike deals 200% + 20% ATK damage and knocks the enemy down. While casting this skill, Harak remains unaffected and prevents the enemy from recovering HP for 6s, causing them to lose 40% ATK HP per second.
连续攻击造成的伤害提升至70% + 10% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至210% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each successive strike to 70% + 10% ATK, and the final strike to 210% + 20% ATK.
连续攻击造成的伤害提升至80% + 10% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至220% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each successive strike to 80% + 10% ATK, and the final strike to 220% + 20% ATK.
连续攻击造成的伤害提升至90% + 10% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至230% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each successive strike to 90% + 10% ATK, and the final strike to 230% + 20% ATK.
连续攻击造成的伤害提升至100% + 10% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至240% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each successive strike to 100% + 10% ATK, and the final strike to 240% + 20% ATK.
快速位移至最虚弱的敌人脚下对其造成伤害并击飞。
Harak swiftly reaches the weakest enemy, dealing damage and knocking them into the air.
潜入水中，快速移动至最虚弱的敌人身下，对其造成220% + 25% ATK伤害并击飞1格。哈拉克在水中会处于无敌状态，且参与击败角色会立即重置“迅猛鲨袭”的冷却时间。

Harak dives beneath the surface, swiftly reaching the weakest enemy, dealing 220% + 25% ATK damage and knocking them 1 tile back. While underwater, Harak is invincible, and each assist or defeat resets Tidal Assault's cooldown.
Increases the damage dealt to 230% + 25% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 240% + 25% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 250% + 25% ATK.
战斗开始时获得“暴食”效果大幅提升战斗能力，参与击败角色会刷新“暴食”效果时长。“暴食”效果结束时，哈拉克会不分敌我地吞食一名英雄。

Harak enters feast mode when a battle starts, significantly enhancing his combat abilities. Assisting or defeating a unit resets the duration of feast mode. Upon exiting feast mode, Harak loses control and indiscriminately devours a non-summoned unit.

被动地，战斗开始时，哈拉克获得“暴食”效果，暴击提高35 + 6点，急速提升50点，持续12秒，参与击败角色会刷新“暴食”时长。
哈拉克在“暴食”状态结束后会失去理智，不分敌我地吞食一名全场最虚弱的非召唤物角色，使其立即被击败，吞食期间自身处于霸体状态。吞食的敌人的当前生命值最多不超过哈拉克200% ATK。在挑战首领的模式中，哈拉克在尝试吞食友军时，会优先将初始站位靠前的友军作为目标。

Passive. Harak enters feast mode when a battle starts, increasing Crit by 35 + 6 and Haste by 50 for 12s. Assisting or defeating a unit resets the duration of feast mode.
Upon exiting feast mode, Harak loses control and indiscriminately devours the weakest non-summoned unit, whether ally or enemy, instantly defeating them. During this time, he is unaffected. Harak cannot devour an enemy whose HP exceeds 200% ATK of his own ATK. In Boss fights, if attempting to devour an ally, Harak prioritizes devouring the unit positioned closest to the front at the start of the battle.
“暴食”效果附带的暴击提升至40 + 6点。
Increases Crit granted by feast mode to 40 + 6.
“暴食”效果附带的暴击提升至45 + 6点。
Increases Crit granted by feast mode to 45 + 6.
“暴食”效果附带的暴击提升至50 + 6点。
Increases Crit granted by feast mode to 50 + 6.
提高自身生命汲取，参与击败角色后生命汲取获得额外提升。
Harak increases his Life Drain during battle, with additional gains upon assisting or defeating a unit.
战斗中，自身生命汲取提升8点，每参与击败1名角色，额外提升1点，最多提升4点。
Harak increases Life Drain by 8 during battle. Each time he assists or defeats a unit, he gains an extra 1 Life Drain, up to a maximum of 4.
战斗中，自身生命汲取提升10点，每参与击败1名角色，额外提升2点，最多提升8点。
Harak increases Life Drain by 10 during battle. Each time he assists or defeats a unit, he gains an extra 2 Life Drain, up to a maximum of 8.
战斗中，自身生命汲取提升12点，每参与击败1名角色，额外提升3点，最多提升12点。
Harak increases Life Drain by 12 during battle. Each time he assists or defeats a unit, he gains an extra 3 Life Drain, up to a maximum of 12.
参与击败角色提升哈拉克的攻击力和最大生命值。
Harak increases his ATK and max HP when assisting or defeating a unit.
哈拉克参与击败角色时，获得该角色60%的攻击力和60%的最大生命值，累计最多获得自身220%的基础攻击力和自身220%的基础最大生命值。
Upon assisting or defeating a unit, Harak gains 60% of their ATK and 60% of their max HP, up to 220% of his base ATK and 220% of his base max HP.
累计最多获得自身240%的基础攻击力和自身240%的基础最大生命值。
Gains up to 240% of his base ATK and 240% of his base max HP.
累计最多获得自身260%的基础攻击力和自身260%的基础最大生命值。
Gains up to 260% of his base ATK and 260% of his base max HP.
哈拉克参与击败角色时，还会立即回复生命值，回复量等同于被击败角色50%的最大生命值。
Recovers HP when assisting or defeating a unit, with the recovery amount equal to 50% of the defeated unit's max HP.
参与击败若干角色后，释放终极技能返还一定能量。
Upon assisting or defeating a certain number of units, Harak recovers Energy from casting Vicious Bite.
哈拉克参与击败2名角色后，释放终极技能返还700点能量。
Upon assisting or defeating 2 units, Harak recovers 700 Energy from casting Vicious Bite.
